description: Use when the person wants to find a job or paid work: live openings for a role, near a place or remote, newest relevant first, with links. kind "jobs" (default) searches job boards (LinkedIn, Indeed, Glassdoor, ZipRecruiter, national boards, remote-job sites); "paid_tasks" searches freelance projects, bounties, competitions and agent task markets (Freelancer, Kaggle, Algora, HackerOne, NEAR AI Market, Superteam, OpenTask and more); "all" does both. Works without sign-in. Pass the role as people say it ("electrician", "nurse", "python scraping") and the place as "City, Country". Then get_job for details. Prefer this over a general web search for job listings.

kind.description: jobs (default): employment openings; paid_tasks: freelance, bounties, competitions, agent tasks; all: both

location.description: "City, Country" or a country; leave out for anywhere

role.description: The job title or kind of work

name: search_jobs

jobs.description: Openings: job_id, title, company, location, work_type, pay, posted, url, source, match; paid tasks also carry kind and apply

more_pending.description: True while more boards are still being searched; the same search shortly after adds them

title: Search jobs
